# Lumaquince 0.1.0 Preview 1 - editable GUI launch profile.
# One NAME=VALUE per line; lines starting with # are ignored.
# An existing environment variable wins over this file. The later user copy at
# %APPDATA%\Lumaquince\nx2_switches.txt (Windows) or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Lumaquince/nx2_switches.txt (Unix) wins over this package copy.
# Restart the emulator after editing. These are existing compatibility variable names.
#
# This profile reproduces the reviewed Ocarina of Time preview setup. Compatibility
# and performance in other titles are not guaranteed. No profiling or capture is enabled.

# Existing GPU thread split and fence batching defaults.
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Explicit preview profile overrides; the underlying C++ defaults are unchanged.
# Native Vulkan draw submission budget. Remove this line to use the default of 128.
EDEN_NX2_FLUSH_DRAWS=4096

# Build all already-cached pipelines at boot, increasing startup work and memory use.
# This does not supply a shader cache or precompile shaders that have never been seen.
# Remove this line to use recent-used-pipeline selection (or the 3000-pipeline limit
# when no used-pipeline list exists).
EDEN_NX2_PRELOAD_ALL_PIPELINES=1
